items.title: CME Group (CME) Unveils European Dairy Futures
items.summary: CME Group (NasdaqGS:CME) introduced a new suite of European dairy futures, marking its first major move into regional agri derivatives. The contracts expand CME Group's existing dairy offering for Europe, building on its partnership with the European Energy Exchange. European producers, processors and traders gain a regulated futures venue designed to help manage milk and dairy price risk on a single platform.
